title: Cosmic Data
note: Subject v2.0. Needs Pydantic 2.x in the Python that runs the tests (the subject installs it with pip in a virtual environment): without it every behaviour test is a SKIP and the end of the run says how to install it; the source checks, flake8 and mypy still run. Each model is imported and fed the subject's field rules at their limits (lengths, ranges, types, DateTime conversion, defaults, Optional), the enums and the @model_validator(mode='after') business rules; main() must create a valid instance and show it, then show the message of a ValidationError it triggers (the example lines and the rule messages are compared as a warning only). Source: imports of pydantic and the standard library only, type hints, no v1 @validator (warning), flake8, mypy.
